__broaden__.δούρατ: δόρυ — beam, timber, plank; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic δούρατα, elided (δούρατ’ = δούρατα) · also neut. acc. pl., ’spears’ (δούρατ’ ἀλεύαντο ’avoided the spears’)
__broaden__.εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω, ’say, speak’) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., standing for an imperative: ’go and tell’ · also aor. inf. dependent on an adjective or wish, ’to tell’ (ποτιφωνήεις … εἰπεῖν ’able to tell’) · also aor. inf. as a prohibition after μή, ’never speak’ (μή ποτε … μέγα εἰπεῖν)
__broaden__.πνείοντες: πνέω — blow, breathe; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., agreeing with οὖροι: ’blowing’ · also pres. part. masc. nom. pl. of persons, with an object: ’breathing (strength)’ (μένος πνείοντες)
__broaden__.περί: περί — around, about; adv. ’exceedingly, beyond others’ (περί τοι μένος ’you have strength beyond others’) · also adv. or preverb with ἦλθε (περί … ἦλθε ’came about’), exact force uncertain · also prep. + gen., ’about, concerning’ (περί τ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων ’about himself and about all’) · also prep. + gen., ’for’, of what is at stake in a fight (περὶ ψυχέων ἐμάχοντο ’fought for their lives’)
__broaden__.ποδὸς: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the part seized: ’by the foot’ · also gen. sg. after ἅπτομαι ’touch’: ’(touch) the foot’ (ποδὸς ἅψεται) · also gen. sg. after ἀντί, of exchange: ’in return for the foot’
__broaden__.ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv. · also with μή, ’ever’: μή ποτε ’never’
__broaden__.τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented before enclitic γ’ · also accented before enclitic τί (τοῦτό τί μοι ’this, I think’) · also accented before enclitic τοι: ’this, for you’
__broaden__.τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic) · also article-like with ἄλλα, ’the other (things)’ (τά περ ἄλλα ’in the other matters’) · also article-like before an adverb, ’the (things) within’ (τά τ’ ἔνδοθι)
__broaden__.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια) · also neut. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cow and the goats · also article-like before an adverb, ’the (things) outside’ (τὰ θύρηφι)
__broaden__.τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’ · also relative, masc./neut. dat. pl. ’on which’ (κώεα, τοῖσιν ἐνεῦδεν ’the fleeces on which he had slept’) · also masc. dat. pl. after ἐν, ’among them’ (ἐν … τοῖσιν) · also neut. dat. pl., ’with those’, pointing back to a group of things: τοῖσιν Ὀδυσσῆος ’with those of Odysseus’
__broaden__.ἄκρον: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; adj., neut. acc. sg. used substantively: ‘the headland’ · also neut. acc. sg. ’the tip, the end’ (of a stake) · also neut. acc. sg. ’the top, the crest’ (of a ridge: ἄκρον ὑπερβαλέειν ’get over the top’) · also adj. acc. sg. with ῥινόν: ’outermost’ (ἄκρον ῥινόν ’the outer skin’)
__broaden__.ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; leave off, give up; fut. 1 pl., used hortatively: ’let us leave off’ · also with an object, ’we will let (him) be’ (τοῦτον μὲν ἐάσομεν) · also fut. 1 pl. + inf., plain future: ’we will allow (them to live)’
__broaden__.ἐπιτρέψαι: ἐπιτρέπω — turn over, entrust, yield; aor. inf. act., after λίσσομαι: ’to entrust’ · also aor. inf. standing for an imperative: ’entrust!’
